description: Query a website's backend logs: filters, word search and aggregations (counts, percentiles, time series). Without aggregations it returns lines, newest first; repeat with cursor set to nextCursor for older ones. Count where failures are first, then read a few lines with fields set. Field names from list_log_sources; at most 31 days.

query.description: from and to (at most 31 days apart), then filters, search and aggregations, or fields for log lines.

aggregations.description: Empty returns log lines, newest first. Otherwise one row per group, with a column per aggregation named fn or fn_field (count, p95_duration_ms).

anyOf.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

field.description: The field to aggregate; null for count.

cursor.description: Continues log lines from a previous result's nextCursor. Repeat the rest of the query unchanged. null for the first page.

items.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

fields.description: Fields to return for log lines; all fields when omitted. null when aggregating.

filters.description: Conditions every returned log line meets.

field.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

op.description: eq and neq match exactly, including case. contains, not_contains and starts_with ignore case. exists and not_exists take no value; in takes a list.

value.description: A list for in, null for exists and not_exists, otherwise one value.

from.description: ISO timestamp with an offset, such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z.

items.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

interval.description: Buckets aggregations over _time, one row per bucket and group, oldest bucket first. When buckets times groups pass limit, the oldest buckets are left out. Needs an aggregation. null for none.

limit.description: Most rows to return; truncated is true when more matched. With an interval, at least one row per time bucket.

field.description: A field name from the log source's field list. Dotted names reach nested fields; field.key reaches a key inside a map field.

orderBy.description: Log lines sort by any field (default _time desc); aggregations sort by an output column (default: time, else the first aggregation). null for the default.

search.description: Whole words to find in any field, ignoring case. Add * for part of a word (time*, *out*). A filter on a known field is faster. null for none.

to.description: ISO timestamp with an offset, such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z.

sourceId.description: Log source id from list_log_sources; needed when the website has several.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: query_logs
title: Query logs
